text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...Finish in the top 3 in a Graded race.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (Target achieved, just as planned with Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey. ...Are you really running in the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I'll enter. It's... my dream, after all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: But this year, that Narita—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "I'm still running!! I want to win the Derby! I'm definitely going to win!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to Brian-san...!
This is a once-in-a-lifetime dream
for me too...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Once in a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Right~! But the Nippon Derby
is totally different from the Satsuki Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
It's the dream stage for everyone involved in racing, so to speak...
And the hype is on a whole other level! It's incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...For every Umamusume who yearns for racing glory,
the 'Derby' is the dream they all aspire to."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (Still, as for me...)

I begin training with Sakura Laurel.
Today, we have one uphill run scheduled.
choice_data_list: Let's cool down as soon as we finish.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Alright, off I go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... gh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (The sheer heat from the girls running on the other course reaches all the way over here.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
The Derby... The Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...For an ordinary Umamusume,
at this point in the Classic season, that's at least two hill climbs.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I'm only doing one.
That's the absolute limit to keep my legs from breaking.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... Haa... Haa...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(While everyone is giving it their all...
fighting for that "one single chance"――)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(—When will the day come
where I can run giving everything I have?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(My once-in-a-lifetime chance is about to begin
...and it'll be over so soon.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...Whoa, careful. We're already at the goal.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(I need to... slow down the pace...
Gradually. Catch my breath while walking.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, isn't that—
...! Whoa, her aura is insane...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek, Brian-san!
We're rooting for your victory in the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh—...
(Thump...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
So fast...
She's in even better shape than at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: So this is a future Derby Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (—I can only see their back now.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(All I could do was walk,
and before I knew it, I was left behind...)
(Thump, thump, thump...)
(—*grit*)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Even I...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...And yet,
I can't suppress the passion
I've poured into this single race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There are times when you just
can't control yourself anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaah—...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...It's going to end.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (It's going to end without me ever getting to run properly.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(My Derby.
My one and only Derby.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I... not yet...!
No... it's not over—"
(Crack—)

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That is all the treatment
we can do for today.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It was extremely mild, so the pain
should subside after a little while.
She should make a full recovery in about a month.
After rushing Sakura Laurel to the hospital, she was diagnosed with a muscle tear.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Considering the condition of your leg,
I would say the symptoms were extremely mild.
Please consider it nothing short of a miracle."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, take care.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"So applying that much force
is where my legs begin to break down, huh."
choice_data_list: Trainer said it was the result of multiple factors overlapping.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...You did mention, for better or worse,
that it wouldn't turn out like this every time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's my own body, so
I know it better than anyone else.
That single step... was the final straw.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad that's all cleared up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Because I've realized where the final line that must never be crossed lies.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I got ahead of myself.
Trying to force myself into the fervor stirred up by everyone around me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I shouldn't be like this, especially when my dream is the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
To think I can't keep my emotions in check."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
could we please avoid talking about the Classic races
between the two of us from now on?"
choice_data_list: Are you... really sure about that?
Are you... really okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ......It's fine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Otherwise... I'll end up falling apart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Because I won't be able to hold back anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
about our goals for the near future...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Shall we keep it the same as before?
'Place 3rd or better in a GIII or higher race' at least once.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Let's not think about anything else, okay?
...For the sake of our dream, the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.'"

Sakura Laurel's eyes tremble faintly.
I possessed no means
to calm the storm within them...
